record.question:
An economist was quoted as saying that the Cost Index (CI) will go up next month because of a recent
        increase in the price of fruit and vegetables.
        Which of the following cannot be inferred from the statement?
options: The cost of fruits and vegetables has risen sharply.
Consumers have decreased their consumption of fruits and vegetables.
The cost of fruit and vegetable is a major item in the CI.
Food cost changes are reflected quickly in the CI.
